Each player has a deck of cards which each represent a specific creature or character, and a pool of 30 mana with which to summon creatures or perform actions. Each character has specific stats and abilities, with stronger characters generally requiring more mana to summon or use their skills. Mana can be replenished by placing creatures on certain tiles, and the goal of each match is to defeat the opponent's leader.

The game includes several modes. The story mode includes eight stages which each unlocks additional cards for the player's deck, and functionally acts as a tutorial. Practice mode lets the player try out new decks, while Ante mode lets the player wager their cards in a match against the computer to acquire new cards. There is also a two-player versus mode with both local play and network play via the XBand service. There are 40 total cards to collect and up to eight different decks can be saved.

141066.overview:
Shanghai is a puzzle game using MahJongg tiles in which you slide available matching tiles off the stack to reveal more tiles. Slide all 144 tiles off the board, and you win the game.

This game includes four versions of the classic Shanghai game: The Great Wall (Shanghai meets Tetris), Beijing (slide rows to make matches), Action Shanghai (clear tiles quickly before more appear), and Classic Shanghai (either regular or face down for an extra challenge).

141067.overview:
Shinouken is a classic one-on-one fighting game. The fighters are eight divine beings, gods struggling against one another to acquire power over the heaven. 

Controls make use of all of the four buttons of the original Neo Geo arcade stick. Available moves, combat moves and combat actions are explained in a section preliminary to the game and are: punch, kick, dash and quick dash, jump, jump attack, throw, super throw, cushion throw (a throw that does nothing but invert the position of the fighters on the fighting field), counterattack, meter build up (the fighter can not move while charging the power meter: once that is done, a Super God move of gargantuan power can be released). It is possible to dash forward, and perform fight moves while on air for a time longer than normal, on account of the preterhuman nature of the battlers (the game is defined as «aerial battle action game» in the spine of Neo Geo version package). Each divinity wields a personal weapon of medieval fashion, like for instance an imposing sword, a bow, a dreadful halberd. Victory goes to who prevails in 2 out of 3 rounds (the duration of each of which is 60 seconds), and a bonus score related with time and energy left is given to them.

Slight gameplay alterations distinguish the Saturn game version.

141068.overview:
Four years later from a previous Kururinpa tournament, the next one is to be held shortly. Ten challengers from all over the world have come to get the opportunity to meet King Paro-Paru, who is the host of the event and can make any of the winner's wishes come true. Who will be the winner this year...?

Shingata Kururin Pa! refines the original game's formula with a few new features. This time around, if a fire block is dropped in a place where it has nothing to burn, it will smolder in place until a nearby fire helps it burst into flames; this allows the player to build some much more complex combos. Each character now also has a unique block type with its own effects.

141349.overview:
Stellar Assault SS is the sequel to the Sega 32X game, Stellar Assault (Shadow Squadron in the US). It was released exclusively for the Sega Saturn in 1998, only in Japan.

Like its prequel, Stellar Assault SS is a first-person (or third person) perspective shooter set in outer space. While the core gameplay remains much the same, Stellar Assault SS is more story-driven, with support characters and voice acting. Ships and environments are also texture-mapped, while some levels take place on planets.

141351.overview: SteamGear Mash is an isometric platformer. It has the (almost) classic case of "kidnap and rescue", except now you play a robot who has to save a little girl called Mina. She was lonely and the scientist with whom she lived built her a robot, called Mash. One day, while these two were playing outside, an alien spaceship came around and fell in love with the girl. He sent his minions to take her and they did. Now it's your job to rescue Mina. There are seven stages, two of which are shoot 'em up stages.

141429.overview: Shippuu Mahou Daisakusen or Kingdom Grandprix is a 2D arcade shooter and racing combination - a continuation of Sorcer Striker. The game has many fantasy creatures and futuristic vehicles. The player chooses 1 of 8 characters - all others are rivals in the race. Player moves faster holding down the fire button (but then he is defenseless), and by getting closer to the top end of the screen. Beside this, the game is a typical vertical-scrolling shooter - player flies forward, shoots enemies and bosses, and collects various power-ups, like extra bombs, homing bullets, or more power to fire the gun. The game has twelve stages, but is non-linear - after completing each level, the player chooses one of the two levels.

141430.overview:
Side Pocket 3 is a Japan-exclusive pocket billiards video game for the Sega Saturn. Like its predecessor, Side Pocket 2, it features the in-game likeness of a real-life professional pool player. In this case, it's JPBA member, Kyoko Sone. The game is the third and final installment of the Side Pocket series.

Unlike the prior installments in the Side Pocket series, Side Pocket 3 renders the pool room environment with 3D polygons. In spite of this, the table can still be viewed in a traditional, top-down fashion.

Play modes consist of: story mode, training mode, trick game mode, and versus mode. Game variants include: eight ball, nine ball, rotation, 14.1 continuous, bowlliards, cutthroat, three ball, poker, pocket game, mitsudama, and yotsudama.

141431.overview:
Sokkou Seitokai: Sonic Council is a 2D fighting game based on the manga of the same title by Masashi Ogawa. The story is set in a high school and focuses on the titular "Sonic Council", a student council at the school made up of students with so-called "tetsuwan" powers that let them use fighting-game style moves and techniques, and who will take on all challengers in order to keep the peace at their school.

The game includes nine playable characters, with an additional three available to unlock. There is a single-player story mode, a versus mode against the computer or a second player, a survival mode where the player must defeat as many opponents as possible with a single life bar and limited recovery options, and a training mode.

141432.overview:
A secret organization called Fata Morgana is developing a weapon that is capable of killing or wounding two-thirds of the world's population. A super-national group of combat experts from all over the world called Project Blue has been established to counteract Fata Morgana's evil doings. 

Sonic Wings Special is an enhanced and expanded port of Aero Fighters Special (Sonic Wings Limited in Japan), a coin-op shoot-'em-up with vertical scrolling. The original coin-op game uses altered levels, graphics and many features from Aero Fighters, Aero Fighters 2 and Aero Fighters 3. 

The home console version adds new characters and endings, new bosses, updated graphics and unlockable planes. There are also Time Attack and 2-player modes. The game uses a branching stage system, so it is impossible to see all levels in one sitting. There is a total of 14 playable characters and many different endings (some of which are reused from previous games in the series). Overall the game has a comic feel.

141433.overview:
Sound Qube is a puzzle game in which the player uses sound cues to identify and eliminate cubes from a stack. Each stage presents the player with a three-dimensional grid of cubes, which is viewed from a corner that shows two sides, and which can be freely rotated to see all sides. The player controls a cursor which can pulse a sonar into a row of blocks; blue sonars can be pulsed into the left face of the stack, while red sonars can be pulsed into the right.

Different types of cubes respond to different types of pulses; once identified, the player can mark the color of a cube. Red, Blue, and White cubes can be eliminated by locking multiple of the same color and firing a sonar pulse, while Purple "Core" cubes can also be locked and eliminated solo, though attempting to eliminate a cube as the wrong color will penalize the player with a loss of energy. The goal of each stage is to find and eliminate all of the Core cubes, which will respond to both red and blue sonar pulses, before the time energy runs out.

141434.overview: Stakes Winner 2: Saikyouba Densetsu is an enhanced home port of Stakes Winner 2. It contains a direct conversion of the original arcade game, including both the Japanese and international releases which contain different races, as well as a new "Original Mode". Original Mode adds simulation and raising elements to the game, with the player using cash winnings to breed and train their very own horse, rather than simply selecting from available horses as in the original game. This version also includes more than 40 additional real-life races.

141435.overview:
Stakes Winner is a horse racing game. 

Races can be entered by one or two players and involve eight horses struggling for victory; each of the eight horses (in the order which the game presents them in: White Heat, Hot Sand, Euro Union, Asian Hope, Brave Lady —the sole female one—, Be Silent, US Fighter, Sky Dancer) given for selection is characterized by three parameters (named «abilities» in-game): speed, stamina, strength, all measured in stars from a minimum of one to a maximum of five. Rival horses are not available for selection to the player: their names are, for instance, the ominous- or hilarious-sounding «Mr Devious», «Red Vision», «Sunk Star», «HelpMe», «OhMygod», «Nutseater». The names are also differentiated by being written all in capital letters the latter ones, normally the former.

Before the beginning of the race, while horses approach the starting point, the name of the circuit, course plan, prize money and circuit time record are displayed. During the race, the indicators on the screen are: the course plan (with a moving coloured circular indicator representing the position of each contender), the chronometric indication of time, the horse's energy bar with a line composed of three segments beside it: a red one (that means the horse is in its full strength), a yellow and a blue one (denoting lack of strength); a representation of the horse's face, which portrays its, more or less fatigued or strong status and how intensely it is running.

141436.overview:
In the aftermath of a great supernatual war, one of the few forms of entertainment is a fighting tournament between users of "Ryoga", a mystical power that manifest souls as a suit of mechanized battle armor. Eight warriors enter the tournament; some seek fame and fortune, some seek a better life, and some simply fight for the thrill.

Steeldom is a third-person arena-based action game and a follow-up to Reverthion by the same developers. It plays very similarly to Sega's Virtual On, and includes eight playable characters each with their own unique moveset and abilities. There is a single-player campaign with unique endings for each character, as well as a 2-player split screen versus mode; the Saturn version adds system link support for two-player matches between two consoles.

141437.overview:
Super Casino Special is a game for up to four players via multitap comprising Baccarat, Roulette, Let It Be, Black Jack, Video Poker, Keno and Slot Machines.

It can be played in two modes, Ranking play or Free Play.
In Ranking mode the player enters a target amount to be reached and then plays against their opponents to see who can reach that amount. If a single player plays in this mode the game provides three opponents but the game caters for up to ten players with the game providing the additional AI opponents. Roulette,Video Poker, and Slot Machines in this game mode are played within a split screen.

In Free mode there are no computer opponents and the games are the same as the games played in Ranking mode though there are minor differences, such as selecting which slot machine to play, because in this mode the split screen mode is not used at all.

There are three kinds of slot machine which can be played for different stakes. Keno is the odd game here because it does not appear on the game menu, instead during any game other than Video Poker a casino hostess pops up in her own little window inviting the player to a game of Keno. If the player accepts they are shown a Keno card on which they mark their numbers after which their current game of Baccarat, Roulette or whatever resumes. A short while later the hostess window opens up again and the hostess gives the good, or more usually bad, news on how good their selections were.

141438.overview: Super Real Mahjong Graffiti is a compilation of all the Super Real Mahjong arcade games up to the Saturn era (besides the first) that were never ported to the SEGA Saturn individually. This means it includes Super Real Mahjong PII, Super Real Mahjong PIII, and Super Real Mahjong PIV. They are not straight ports, however, as there have been some changes, such as improved graphics to the earlier games. There are six girls to challenge to strip mahjong. Strip sequences are animated.

141439.overview:
Super Real Mahjong P7 (スーパーリアル麻雀Ｐ７) is a 1997 arcade mahjong game in Seta's Super Real Mahjong series ported to the Sega Saturn the following year. The port appears to have been significantly toned down from previous ports, earning an "18 and up" rating from Sega of Japan's classification system instead of the usual "X" rating (or it may be that Sega became more lenient; what happened is unknown).

More animated strip mahjong awaits in the seventh arcade game in the Super Real Mahjong series. Challenge three more lovely girls, Yurina Asahina, Natsuki Asahina, and Serika Randoh, and they'll take their clothes off for you. And if you win at least one match with a baiman hand or higher, the fun won't end with just the three of them...

141440.overview:
Super Real Mahjong PV is the fifth installment in the strip mahjong series. There is no background story in the game; the player is merely introduced to three high school girls - Mizuki, Aya, and Akira - who challenge him to the game of mahjong. The main mahjong mode is that of the one-on-one variety; after each successfully completed round the girl removes a part of her clothing.

The computer versions of the game contain scenes with nudity; among the console versions, the PC-FX one is the only one that similarly lacks censorship. Some of the versions have secondary gameplay modes, such as a team mode in which the player controls three girls and plays mahjong against three others.

141441.overview: The sixth arcade game in the Super Real Mahjong series. In a manner extremely similar to previous entries in the series, you play strip mahjong with three lovely females, this time around with Tamami Kayama, Yukari Kinomiya, and Mari Kurihara. This game, however, has a new feature: an "emotion system." Each girl has a heart meter, and if you manage to fill them all, you can play against the secret fourth opponent.

146544.overview:
Japan, 1920's. After having defeated the ultimate evil, the charming ladies of the Hanagumi Squad and their young commander Ichiro Ogami believe that Japan is safe forever. But their archenemy is resurrected by a mysterious hand. And even though the heroes defeat him once again, they realize that sooner or later they'll have to confront the masked demon who has brought their foe back to life, find out who or what is pulling the strings behind the scene, and revive once again the tragic past.

Being a direct continuation to the first Sakura Taisen, the second installment is very similar to it graphically and gameplay-wise. The game is divided into adventure and battle modes. In adventure mode, the player controls Ichiro Ogami, moving around the theater (into which the base is disguised), trying to initiate conversations with the girls and choosing timed responses, which influence the hero's relationship with the girl and also slightly affect her parameters in combat. Battles are pre-set and take place on large isometric fields, on which the player navigates mech-piloting girls and Ichiro himself, fighting enemy forces in turn-based combat. There are two new characters in the game, and several refinements to the timed answer system.

149669.overview:
Shinsetsu Samurai Spirits: Bushidou Retsuden (unofficially known in the Western world as Samurai Shodown RPG) is a Japanese-style role-playing game based on the Samurai Shodown universe. The player has to explore the world, find items, participate in battles, and acquire accessories that will contribute to his success.

The player can start the adventure as any of the six personages that are available (Haohmaru, Nakoruru, Genjuro Kibagami, Galford D. Weller, Ukyo Tachibana and Cham Cham). The main line of the argument does not diverge much depending on the player's choice; the differences will be more noticeable in the dialogues or the appearance of some character-focused scenes thorough the game.

The fighting mode is fairly different from those found in most other Japanese-style RPGs: the moves are executed by pressing the same button combinations as in the arcade fighting games.

149693.overview:
When a high school girl gets a sudden transfer to the prestigious boarding school her parents went to, she expects her life has nowhere to go but up. She's immediately thrust into the school's complicated political dynamics, where she has to ask herself: who is that strange, menacing girl who keeps showing up? What is this student council that seems to rule the school from the shadows? Why does someone seem to have it in for her? And why does it feel like there's something about their past her parents aren't telling her?

Based on the classic anime Revolutionary Girl Utena, this game lets the player experience surreal school life at Ohtori Academy. Instead of having the player take control of one of the show's characters, the game's protagonist is a brand-new character meeting the cast for the first time. Players can make alliances (and enemies) as they interact with characters and settle in; the story branches based on how characters feel about the protagonist, with nine possible endings and an enormous number of branching story paths. A page in the player's student handbook shows the player how every one of the main cast feels about her, letting the player be strategic with the route they take through the game.

Utena captures the show's aesthetic with art and music taken directly from the show alongside new artwork, cutscenes and music which match the original show's presentation. All dialogue is fully voice-acted with the original actors from the show reprising their roles, alongside new actors playing the game's original characters.

155501.overview:
Sonic Z-Treme is a new game for the Sega Saturn inspired by the ill-fated Sonic X-Treme.

While Sonic X-Treme relied on sprites and the fisheye view camera and worked correctly only on pc, this game relies heavily on 3D, including the player's model and enemy models, while also aiming for a stable 30 FPS on the Sega Saturn.
This game also includes a splitscreen multiplayer mode where you can either play the full game versus or coop!

157159.overview: Sakura Taisen Hanagumi Tsuushin (サクラ大戦 花組通信) is a Sega Saturn interactive newsletter on events concerning the Sakura Taisen franchise.

157160.overview: Sakura Taisen: Jouki Radio Show is a multimedia fan disc and newsletter for the Sakura Wars series. It contains video and photos of Sakura Wars events and shows, cast interviews, a music selection, and several mini-games. The main game feature is Feeling Couple, a short visual novel-style story in which the player invites one of the six girls on a date. There is also a selection of other small mini-games each centered around one of the characters, such as an indoor curling game with Sakura, a karate chop game with Kanna, and a robot-building game with Kohran.

157161.overview:
Sangokushi Kōmeiden is the second installment in the Sangokushi Eiketsuden series.

Unlike its predecessor, Sangokushi Kōmeiden relies heavily on the player's ability and success in each combat to determine how the game will conclude. The game tracks the player's overall record by monitoring the character's overall health and counting the number of times the player has resorted from battle and restarted a level, in addition to having decisions at the beginnings of most stages that affect troop placements for both sides, event triggers, and the items found in armories and granaries. Zhuge's health will be badly harmed if he takes too many rounds to reach a specific point in the tale, or if he restarts fights too many times, and if he becomes too weak, he will die before the final Battle of Wuzhang Plains takes place. If the player's skill level is high enough, Zhuge Liang will pretend to die, leading his adversary, Sima Yi, out into the open. After then, the game will go to the last chapter, which will feature a series of climactic conflicts against the kingdoms of Cao Wei and Sun Wu.

157162.overview:
Romance of the Three Kingdoms V is the fifth game in the popular turn-based strategy game series, based on the classic medieval Chinese novel "San Guo" ("Three Kingdoms"). The novel, written by Luo Guanzhong, is perhaps the most popular classic book in China and all countries influenced by the Chinese culture (such as Japan). Its events occur in the third century AD, during the Later Han Dynasty. Several army leaders (the most important ones being Liu Bei, Cao Cao, Sun Jian) are trying to unite China under their rule, and each one strives to defeat his opponents.

Romance of the Three Kingdoms V offers many innovations. You won't only participate at wars, but also manage your country, and learn resource management of people and goods. A new "Reputation" parameter directly affects the people's opinion of you as the leader. Multiplayer allows participation of up to eight players (playing the eight main characters).

The game was never translated into English. It was released in Japan for the PC (both DOS and Windows), Saturn and PlayStation. A Chinese translation of the game (DOS version) is available.

157163.overview:
Sankyo Fever S is pachinko simulation game, and the first in the Fever series to be released on the Saturn. It contains digital recreations of six real-life pachinko machines made by Sankyo:

• CR Fever Beach
• Fever Nin Nin Emaki SP
• CR Fever Big Powerful FX
• Carrot Boy
• Missile 7-7-6D
• Akudaman SP

There is no campaign or story mode, but each machine has various configuration and stat tracking options and can be freely played.

The limited-edition release includes six trading cards featuring photos of the included pachinko machines, but is otherwise identical.

157164.overview:
SD Gundam: G Century S is a turn-based strategy game based on the popular Mobile Suit Gundam anime franchise. It is a precursor to the long-running G Generation strategy series, and includes units and scenarios from various Gundam series and media up through 1996's After War Gundam X. The game is a top-down hex-based strategy game where up to four factions take turns moving their units to attempt to defeat their opponents. When two units engage in combat, the battles take the form of side-scrolling action sequences which are directly controlled by the player.

In addition to the main scenario mode, there is also a single map mode where the player can select any map type and set of factions, two challenge modes, an action battle mode which contains only the combat sequences, and a formation edit mode. Up to four players can compete on one map.

This version includes some minor balance changes and additional unit types but is otherwise the same game as the PS1 title.

157165.overview:
Sega Saturn de Hakken!!: Tamagotchi Park is a tamagotchi game for the Sega Saturn. It came with a Saturn Backup Memory cartridge.

Several Sega characters cameo in this game as Tamagotchi creatures the player can raise, namely Sonictchi, Pengo, Opa-Opa, Alex Kidd and Flicky. These Tamagotchi versions only appeared in this game.

The game serves as a complimentary entry for another Saturn game based on a popular Bandai franchise (also originated from a virtual pet toy), this being Digital Monster Ver. S Digimon Tamers.

157166.overview: Seikai Risshiden is a politics-themed digital board game for up to four players where the players compete to win an election. Each player selects their avatar's background, such as journalist, celebrity, or businessman, which affects their starting money and fame, and then takes turns moving around the board via dice roll. Different spaces have different effects; some may ask the player a question which will affect their public perception, while others may trigger events such as campaign events or sports tournaments that affect that player's status. Election day occurs once any player reaches the goal, and the winner — as in real life — is determined by the votes that are tallied.

157167.overview:
The protagonist of the game is a Japanese high school student, who was frequently transferred from school to school in various cities of Japan. During the summer holidays, he receives an anonymous letter, containing only one sentence: "I want to meet you". He decides to travel to all the cities where he attended high school, and resume the contact with the girls who could have sent him this letter. But which one did send it, and which one is going to be his true love?..

Sentimental Graffiti is what is usually referred to as dating simulation. Instead of following a story, like in adventure games, the player makes choices that influence his relationships with the game's female characters, thus shaping his own story.

There are twelve cities to travel to, and twelve girls to have a relationship with. Compared to some other dating simulations (such as Tokimeki Memorial games), the gameplay system in Sentimental Graffiti is rather simple, focusing on freedom of movement and choice rather than statistics.

The player can choose between various means of transportation (different kinds of train, plane, boat, etc.), and different locations within each city. The backgrounds are digitized photos of real locations in Japan, while the characters are hand-drawn anime style pictures.

157168.overview: She'sn (aka "season") is a visual novel love adventure game which focuses on a four different stories through all four seasons. The player can select to play the story of any season in any order. Different season also features different heroines and different love stories to play through. The spring story revolves around a forbidden love with your sister-in-law. The summer season tells the love story with your childhood friend. Love story in the fall is about the school romance. And the winter season is a sad love story between the protagonist and a girl with an incurable disease.

157169.overview: Shin Megami Tensei Devil Summoner: Akuma Zensho is a companion disc for the game that includes new artwork and expanded information on all creatures and locations in the game.

157170.overview: Shinpi no Sekai: El-Hazard (神秘の世界エルハザード) is based off of an anime with the same title. The protagonist of the story is a young high-school student boy, Makoto Mizuhara, who finds himself, due to various circumstances, tossed into the fantasy world of El-Hazard. While the main character and the setting is based on the anime, this is a completely new story with certain changes and new characters. The game plays like an enhanced visual novel which is fully voice-acted and displays protagonist and other characters on the screen during dialogues. Event scenes and animations are quite common, and character poses depicting their current disposition is displayed in portrait images which are also animated. Unlike typical visual novels where the player is limited to dialogue and choices, players can explore various locations on the map and try to perform actions outside the dialogue window, such as initiating a talk to other characters, or look around the area or go someplace else.

157171.overview:
A Japan-only release of a Neon Genesis Evangelion episode in the form of a video game. Following the story of the popular animé series, the game presents an episode of its own. The player controls Shinji Ikari, the main character of the series. A new Angel appears and attacks Unit-01. As a result, Shinji loses his memory. His friends decide he should fight Asuka in Unit-02, hoping his memory will be restored as a result of the battles.

The game contains many cut-scenes made by Gainax, the creators of the TV series. Many scenes are taken directly from original Neon Genesis Evangelion episodes. The player gains control when they have to make decisions for Shinji (choose correct answers, etc.), and when fighting Angels. The player should figure out which attack the Angel is using, and press corresponding buttons to defend and to counterattack it.

157172.overview: This is the second Neon Genesis Evangelion "interactive animé" for Saturn. The events of the game take place just after Episode 14 of the TV series. A new girl called Magumi arrives to the school where the hero of the series Shinji Ikari studies. The two start developing feelings for each other, when a new Angel attacks. The player controls Shinji through series of decisions (there are now three or four choices each time, as opposed to the prior game that had only two, and a branching story line) and through the fights. Much of the movie footage depicting combat is presented in 3D. The player selects moves from time to time; correct selections lead to the continuation of the movie - and hence, the game.

157174.overview:
This is a Japanese-style adventure game based on the popular TV anime series Neon Genesis Evangelion. A girl named Mana Kirishima arrives at Tokyo-3 and studies in the same class with Shinji Ikari, the series' main hero. About the same time, a giant robot attacks the city. Is there a connection between the new student and the sudden assault?

Unlike the two previous Neon Genesis Evangelion games, Kōtetsu no Girlfriend is not an interactive movie. The player controls Shinji by selecting locations to travel to, looking at people, and talking to them. The locations are graphically represented as anime-style still screens.

157192.overview:
Jurio is a young boy who must travel to five sacred shrines as part of his warrior initiation rite. The lovely magician Chris accompanies him on his journey. But soon the two young people discover that they must face dangers far beyond those they have imagined. The prophecy of the mysterious White Witch is about to be fulfilled: a great wave will destroy the entire world of Tirasweel if nobody stops the man behind it...

The third entry in Legend of Heroes series (and also the first without the reference to Dragon Slayer universe in its title) introduces a new battle system: the battles in the game occur in pre-set locations, and evolve automatically. The player's task is to program the actions of the heroes (up to four in the party) before the battle. There are eight total "programs", with five moves each (for example, "attack", "attack", "cast healing magic", "attack", "cast offensive magic", etc.), and the player can switch between them during the battle.

Other game elements in Shiroki Majo are fairly typical for a Japanese-style RPG, including reliance on plot events, linear progression through the story, automatic leveling, etc.

157193.overview: Shouryuu Sangoku Engi is a historical simulation game set in the Three Kingdoms era of Chinese history. The player chooses from one of four scenarios and more than a dozen warlords, with the ultimate goal of unifying china under their rule. While the player can issue direct commands and decrees and attack neighboring territory, the bulk of the gameplay consists of assigning generals and officers and managing many aspects of the kingdom, from the makeup of armies to diplomatic relations with other warlords.

157194.overview: Shunsai is a horse racing database and simulation software which includes detailed race records for Japanese horse racing between January 1986 and April 1996. The main features are the database of race and horse information, as well as a simulator in which the player can select one of many famous races, along with a lineup of real-life horses to simulate the results of that race. There is also a quiz mode with three difficulty levels which tests the player's knowledge of horse racing.

157195.overview:
Simulation RPG Tkool is, much akin to its brethren in the RPG Maker line of games, a construction kit and editor to make RPGs. In this case, it's "simulation" RPGs or, as they're more commonly known, tactical/strategy RPGs in the vein of Fire Emblem and Shining Force.

The construction kit gives the player a menu based interface where it's possible to change almost every detail of the game being made, down to the character sprites, background music and individual statistics for each character.

157202.overview:
Lina, Gourry, and Naga are barely together for a day before finding themselves yet again as the only thing standing in the way of world-wide cataclysm. It's up to them, as well as many returning friends, to save to world, or what will be left of it anyways.

Gameplay in Slayers Royal takes place in a mixture of 2D town screens and 3D turn based battle arenas. In towns you can move between multiple areas as well as look at objects and people to examine or talk to them. Lina will often get into (occasionally voiced) conversations with her companions, and in most conversations choices can come up that determine if the party receives stat upgrades or money. In battle each character in the party can be controlled either manually, or left up to an automated AI. Most characters can use magic, but each spell has a wait time that prevents a character from casting more magic until enough turns have passed. Characters do not gain strength or money from battle, instead strength is determined by how rested and full the stomachs of the characters are before combat.

157203.overview:
That didn't take long. Only a few months after the events of Slayers Royal and already Lina, Gourry, and an even larger cast of characters will have to save the world yet again. If they don't all kill each other first, of course.

Slayers Royal 2 plays similarly to the first game, but with several tweaks. You can no longer look at any object on a town screen, but there is now an event button that will automatically talk to anyone on the screen you're able to talk to. The passage of days from the first game has been expanded to include five times of day, and some events only happen at specific times. In combat the automatic turn system from the first game has been replaced with a more traditional one turn at a time. Terrain now has variable height, and can be raised or lowered with specific spells. Finally a spell's wait time is now reflected in the time it takes a character to cast a spell, making it possible to avoid a spell or attack a caster to prevent the spell from finishing.

157207.overview: Sotsugyou Album is a fan disc for the Sotsugyou series. The disc features artwork, video clips from the voice actors etc.

157208.overview:
Sotsugyou Crossworld is love adventure game and a spinoff of the Graduation series featuring the main heroines from the first two games, with the player controlling a fellow student rather than a teacher as in the main games. All five girls from each game appear, along with two new girls for a total of 12, though only seven can be dated in this version of the game.

The player is cast as a student who hopes to find a girlfriend before his final high school summer vacation is over. The player can visit various locations around Yokohama to try to meet the various girls; meet up with a girl enough times to build up affection and various special events will occur, with the ultimate goal of successfully asking one of the girls out before the end of summer.

Sega Saturn port of Sotsugyou Crossworld includes significant additional content over the original PlayStation release: there are new events and endings for five additional characters, meaning all 12 girls can now be dated in this version, and there is also a new original voice drama included.

157210.overview:
Graduation is a Japanese anime "life-sim" game. You take the role of a homeroom teacher who is given the responsibility of teaching five girls in their last year of high school. You determine their class schedules, do guidance counseling, interfere with their weekend plans, and occasionally take to the streets to make sure they're not getting into trouble. Each of the girls have their own individual personality and problems, and the choices you make will determine whether they graduate from high school, what they do with their lives afterwards, and whether or not they wind up hating your guts. Get them all into top colleges and your boss will praise your genius. If they all flunk or wind up wanting to marry you, you'll obviously be fired.

Despite what common sense and knowledge of the Japanese psyche might lead you to believe, this is not an adult (or hentai) game and there's no nudity and only an average amount of anime sexploitation.

157216.overview:
In the 12th century, the Emperor Hui Zhong is faced with an internal rebellion led by Imperial Minister Gao Qiu. The Song Dynasty comes to an end, and Gao Qiu became the new ruler. You take the role of an exiled ruler, and you must build your stats up to be able to challenge- and destroy- Gao Qiu and restore Hui Zhong to the throne.

The game is a military strategy game, like most of Koei's games, but instead of conquering a country, the goal is to depose the despotic ruler of China. You start out lowly, and have to work your way up by conquering smaller prefectures, forming alliances, and fighting small battles. You have to earn the right to attack Gao Qiu's home prefecture, though- he is off limits until you are powerful.

157217.overview:
Suikoden: Tendou 108-sei is a historical simulation game based on the classic Chinese novel Water Margin, and a sequel to Bandit Kings of Ancient China. The overall concept and structure are very similar to the previous game, with the player controlling a warlord in 12th-century China, accruing power and popularity with the goal of challenging the corrupt minister Gao Qiu.

This entry brings a greater focus and depth on the simulation mechanics and on individual characters. The main simulation proceeds in real-time, with the player maintaining their stronghold and managing their territory primarily via menu commands. Skirmishes between factions take the form of turn-based tactical battles. The game includes two scenarios available from the start, with a third unlocked after completing either of the first two.

157218.overview:
The game takes place 4 months after the events of Super Robot Wars 3.

A special, but shady, secret police force, the Titans, are created in response to terrorist acts and internal trouble between the Earth and its space colonies. Meanwhile in the shadow old and new enemies menaces Earth: they are the Poseidals (aliens from outer space), the Guests (another alien race) and the now rebuilt DC army. Super Robot Wars F and Super Robot Wars F Final (also known as "Super Robot Taisen F Kanketsuhen") were originally thought as an unique title but due to production delays the game was split in two parts. F covers the first 34 stages of the game, F Final deals with stages from 35 to the end of the game. It's possible to import a savegame from F and continue the game from here or to start F Final from scratch with default settings and units.

Gameplay mechanics are the same of Super Robot Wars 4. The title is a turn based strategic game. When attacked by an enemy, the player can react in three ways: counter, evade (halves enemy % of landing an attack on the player) or defend (if hit, the player receives only half of the damage).

157219.overview:
Super Robot Taisen F Kanketsuhen picks up where Super Robot Taisen F left, starting at stage 35. F and F Kanketsuhen were originally thought as an unique game, but production delays made the producers decide to split the game in two parts.

This game features the first appearance of Mazinkaiser (created by contaminating the Mazinger Z with Getter rays). Gameplay mechanics are the same of Super Robot Wars 4 (and Super Robot Taisen F, of course). It's a turn strategy game, when attacked the player can decide to counter, to dodge (halves the % of being hit) and to defend (it halves the damage eventually received).

157220.overview:
Follow the story of an absent-minded young sorceress Lucienne and her gang of misfit monsters, as they try to stop the evil mage Death Shadow from destroying the world.

Sword & Sorcery is a game in classic roleplaying genre, but presented in full 3D graphics (and sprite characters) uncommon for the time. The battles are fought in traditional turn-based manner, but allow for more strategy than most classic RPGs. The game places ambient obstacles on the battlefield to block some attack paths, but allows the player to strategically reposition his fighters along the bottom two rows of the map before every turn to take advantage of the terrain.

The game also features a dynamic day/night system which serves little purpose other than changing one of your party members from human into a werewolf and back.

166330.overview:
It is the Taishou Era in Japan, and the Western world has begun to make its way through traditional Japan. Technology is evolving, and the use of steam has made for great breakthroughs in transportation in weaponry. But the world faces a deadly threat: a dark cult wishes to destroy Japan and the very world itself. To combat any possible threats, the Imperial government of Japan brings together 6 young ladies from around the world to form the Hanagumi (Flower Bridage) division of the Teikoku Kagekidan (Imperial Floral Assault Group). Clad in their proud spiritual armor, the Kobou, these young women are the frontline of defense against the demon worshippers, but they haven't a leader to guide them into battle.

And, with a single letter, young Navy ensign Ichiro Ogami's life is about to take a very interesting turn as the chosen leader of the Hanagumi! Ichiro now has to gain the trust of the members of the Hanagumi if he expects to keep things under control.

The gameplay of Sakura Taisen is a combination of Japanese-style adventure with dating mechanics and tactical turn-based combat. Most of the game is spent exploring the theater, which serves as a disguise for the military base. Depending on the player's decisions - where to go, which girl to look for, how to answer the questions (there is a time limit for responses) - the protagonist will develop different relationships with the girls, which will influence not only further dialogues and the ending, but also slightly affect their parameters in battles. During combat, the player navigates Ichiro and the girls over an isometric battlefield and attack the enemies physically, or charge for powerful special attacks. Each turn it is possible to perform two different actions per character; walking distance and attack range are limited and unique to each character. There is no experience points system and also no equipment in the game.

166404.overview: Set in the aerial world "Gotha World", this is the great epic story that depicts the fight between the private garrison where the main character belongs and the pirate guild! After deciding operations for all units for both allies and enemies, the "Personal Time System" in action will greatly influence the outcome of the battle! Predicting the enemy 's actions, making strategy plans and carry out the actions in battle will be the key to victory!

173881.overview:
Bootleg Sampler, despite its name, is an official Sega Saturn demo disc packaged with new consoles for a period in both North America and Europe. Like later demo discs, it features a number of playable demos and movie clips.

Playable demos:
• Bug! (Only playable in the second and third versions. The first US version contains a Bug! FMV rather than said demo).
• Clockwork Knight 2 (1995 demo)
• Sega Rally Championship (1995-10-02 demo)
• World Series Baseball (Saturn) (1995-09-29 demo)

Videos:
• Bug! (Only in the first US version. The second and third versions contain a playable demo of Bug!, instead of the video).
• Daytona USA
• NHL All-Star Hockey
• Mystaria - The Realms of Lore
• Panzer Dragoon
• Virtua Cop
• Virtua Fighter 2
• Wing Arms
• A compilation video, containing clips from Ghen War, Cyber Speedway, Virtua Fighter Remix, Black Fire, Astal, Mr. Bones, Congo the Movie: The Lost City of Zinj and The Mansion of Hidden Souls.

174961.overview:
Super Keirin is a bicycle racing game based specifically on keirin cycle racing, produced by the Japan Keirin Association. Keirin races are professional bicycle races held on an oval track; at the start of a race, competitors must remain behind a pace cyclist, which gradually increases in speed before leaving the track in the latter part of the race when the competitors sprint for final position. Races have a field of 9 competitors and take place on tracks either 333m, 400m, or 500m in length.

The game includes a single race mode for up to four human players against the computer, a basic career mode, a watch mode, and a database of information on real-life keirin tracks. It was a promotional item given away at Keirin events related to the sport's 50th anniversary in 1998, and was never sold at retail.

175376.overview:
Sotsugyou: Graduation S puts the player into a position of a high school teacher, whose goal is to successfully lead five female students to graduation within the same semester. In order to do that, the player has to study the individual characteristics of the girls. Each girl has different parameters, different strengths and weaknesses. The teacher should be careful not to overload the students with work, but letting them do what they want is not the right way either. The teacher has also control on other aspects of the students' life: it is possible to have personal conversations with the girls to motivate them, and choose leisure activities for them (such as going to the cinema). The girls can become displeased with the teacher or sick, so it's important to keep the morale high in order to achieve successful graduation.

This version is an enhanced port of the original Graduation. It includes a handful of new events and vocal music tracks, along with newly redrawn graphics. Also included in the package are a student notebook and a badge styled after the Seika Girls' High School emblem.

175379.overview:
Hudson Soft New Soft Line Up for Sega Saturn, also called Hudson Shinsaku Preview (ハドソン 新作 プレビュー), is a demo disc published by Hudson Soft for the Sega Saturn containing demos of five Hudson games:

• Bulk Slash
• Willy Wombat
• Virus
• Koden Koureijutsu Hyaku Monogatari: Hontoni Atta Kowai Hanashi
• Momotarou Douchuuki

175381.overview: Shutsudou! Miniskirt Police is a mini-game collection and multimedia fan disc based on the TV variety program of the same title that ran on TV Tokyo between 1996 and 2005. There are five simple games in the package: a low-rider hydraulics competition, a top-down driving game where the player must avoid obstacles, a Breakout-style brick-breaker game, a vertical shooting game, and a card-matching memory game. All five games are themed around catching a glimpse of the titular characters' underwear. There are also two quiz games, a photo gallery, and numerous video clips of the actresses both in and out of uniform.

175383.overview: Sakura Taisen: Teigeki Graph is a multimedia fan disc for the Sakura Wars series, containing an original side-story and a collection of five mini-games such as a piano rhythm game and a jigsaw puzzle. Also included are a Sakura Taisen encyclopedia, illustration and video galleries, and a selection of cast interviews.

175384.overview:
Standby Say You! is a simulation game where the player takes the role of an up-and-coming voice director. The player character is the apprentice of real-life voice actor and director Shigeru Chiba, and is suddenly thrust into their first leading job as the voice director of a new anime series called "Interrupt Girl" after the original director suddenly leaves the project.

In-game, the player interacts with the actors in simple adventure-style sequences, watches clips of tryouts, and gives feedback to each of the actors. The console versions also add several mini-games such as matching voice clips with the correct actor.

175440.overview:
Shinseiki Evangelion: Digital Card Library is a fan disc and minigame collection based on the 1995 anime series. The game contains many dozens of "digital trading cards" to collect and browse, which mostly contain various short video clips of the show; some also contain episode previews, merchandise photos, original mini-comics, or additional minigames. Completing the games will unlock additional cards and games to play.

There are a total of nine different minigames, including an Evangelion trivia quiz, a Simon-says type game where the player must remember the direction of light flashes on Gendo's glasses, and a maze game where Shinji must get beer for Misato from vending machines.

175632.overview:
Sakamoto Ryouma: Ishin Kaikoku is a historical simulation game set in the Bakumatsu period of Japanese history. It centers around real-life political figure Ryoma Sakamoto, who was instrumental in ending a 250-year period of Japanese isolationism and restoring the Emperor of Japan to power over the shogunate. The player selects one of over 500 possible characters, from the famous Sakamoto himself, down to simple traders and scholars. The ultimate goal of the game is to unify the ideology of the Japanese people and bring about the Meiji Restoration.

The game primarily consists of meeting with people in the many villages in order to convince them to join your cause, looking for those who may be sympathetic. This is accomplished through a menu-based conversation mini-game where the player must choose their words and approach in order to align the other character's feelings with their own. Once the player's influence has sufficiently grown, they can hold faction meetings and delegate various tasks to their followers, including recruiting more people or attempting to assassinate threats. The player's faction can also be attacked, and so care must be taken not to arouse too much attention from the shogunate. The game includes over 150 real-life historical events that can occur.

175634.overview:
Sakura Tsuushin is a romantic visual novel adventure which follows the story of Touma Inaba, the protagonist, who is trying to get into Keio University. On the day the exam scores are posted, he meets Mieko Yotsuba, a redhead he falls in love to at first sight. After he finds out she got in, but didn't, he decides to lie and say he passed the exam and got into in order to impress her. He lives with Urara Kasuga who has an unrequited love for him, which is the only reason why she doesn't tell anyone that he is not really a college student and helps him in his love pursuit.

The game features anime style video clips as well as dialogues with slightly animated characters on static backdrops which forwards the story, branching it based on players actions and answers during conversation with other characters. Save game options is only available at key points in the story and cannot be done anywhere during gameplay as is case with most of visual novels. Bottom screen is used for text and does not have opacity, with graphical content appearing only in the upper area, whether static images or video clips. Certain key animations are done in full screen.

175635.overview:
In the 3rd century AD, the powerful warlord Liu Bei accompanied by his blood brothers Guan Yu and Zhang Fei, begins to raise an army to battle his way across China to ultimately obtain the title of Emperor, and restore the Han dynasty.

Throughout the story-driven campaign, the player will have to win 64 battles. Each battle has its own victory condition within a turn limit. The player will need to wisely allocate soldiers of multiple types and devise strategies to overwhelm an opposing army. Every garrison of soldiers are led by their own officers. The chosen battles will determine the outcome of the campaign and how the story advances.

In between battles there are settlements where information can be obtained from citizens, shops that sell weapons and items to enhance the player's soldiers, and Liu Bei can meet with his officers to formulate plans for the next move.

175636.overview: Sangokushi IV with Power-Up Kit (三國志Ⅳ ｗｉｔｈ パワーアップキット) is a re-released version of Sangokushi IV for the Sega Saturn, adding the contents of the game's expansion pack (or "power-up kit" as it is known in this context).

175637.overview: Sangokushi Returns is a remake of the original Romance of the Three Kingdoms from 1985. The strategy gameplay is identical to the original release — select one of several warlords vying for power in the aftermath of the Yellow Turban Rebellion in the year 184 CE, and attempt to conquer territory — but this remake features completely redone graphics and sound similar to the previous remake of Nobunaga's Ambition. All 250+ generals are now rendered in full 3D, and there is a full remixed soundtrack including many songs appearing from other games in the series.

175641.overview: Sankyo Fever S Vol.2 is pachinko simulation game, and part of the Fever series. It contains digital recreations of three real-life pachinko machines made by Sankyo: CR Fever Pistol Daimyo SR, Fever Pistol Daimyo GP, and Fever Hanafuda GP; each can be freely played with various pin configurations. There is also a story mode where the player can pursue a relationship with one of two cute girls in between pachinko sessions.

175663.overview: Sankyo Fever S Vol.3 is pachinko simulation game, and part of the Fever series. It contains digital recreations of five real-life pachinko machines made by Sankyo: CR Fever Super Nine JX, Fever Magical Mumu-chan, Fever Powerful III, Fever Queen II, and Fever Big Chime. There is no campaign or story mode, but each machine has various configuration and stat tracking options and can be freely played.

175664.overview:
Saturn Music School is an educational game that teaches the basics of playing the piano. It includes a multi-stage tutorial mode, 20 popular songs to play along with, and a composition mode where the player can write their own music. There are also several mini-games included: the first tasks the player with repeating notes as they're played; the second tasks the player with repeating a sequence of notes; and the third is a quiz that asks basic questions about music.

The package includes an adapter to connect a standard MIDI keyboard (not included), which is required to play the game.

175665.overview: Saturn Music School 2 is a follow-up to Saturn Music School which includes 30 new songs to play piano along with. It also includes the same selection of tutorial modes and composition tool as the first game. The package includes an adapter to connect a standard MIDI keyboard (not included), which is required to play the game.

175666.overview: SeaBass Fishing 2 is a bass fishing game endorsed by and featuring the likeness of professional Japanese professional fisherman and author Seikai Murakoshi. It is a follow-up to Sea Bass Fishing, including the same selection of modes: Tournament Mode is the main campaign where the player competes in a series of fishing tournaments with specific restrictions and increasing difficulty; Free Fishing mode lets the player set the time, equipment, and environment conditions and freely fish at any of the four locations. There is also an Instruction mode with video clips of Mr. Murakoshi explaining the basics of bass fishing, and a Cooking mode which describes various real-life meal recipes for preparing fresh bass.

175668.overview: Sekai no Shasou kara I Swiss-hen: Alps Tozantetsudou no Tabi is a digital gallery for the Sega Saturn.

175669.overview:
Li Xiaoyao is a young man who studies martial arts under the guidance of his aunt, an owner of an inn which is often visited by famous adventurers and heroes. Seeing those heroes, Li Xiaoyao dreams of becoming one himself. And of course, the mind of the young man is also occupied with pretty girls.

Finally his dream of becoming an adventurer comes true, but not quite in the fashion he wanted it to be. His aunt becomes gravely sick, and the only way to save her is to find a legendary medicine. During his journey to the land where he hopes to find the medicine, Li Xiaoyao meets the beautiful Zhao Ling'er, who is persecuted by ruthless enemies. The grand adventure of Li Xiaoyao's life begins.

Xianjian Qixia Zhuan is the first entry in the Chinese-made Legend of Sword and Fairy role-playing game series. The game is set in feudal China and features supernatural elements. Gameplay-wise, it is very close to Japanese RPGs. The player controls a party of heroes which he navigates through towns and maze-like dungeons, buying weapons and accessories and searching for treasure. Story progression is linear for the most part. There is no overworld in the game; however, some areas are seamlessly connected to each other and can be explored in a different order.

There are no random enemy encounters in the game: all enemies are visibly walking on the field and can sometimes be avoided. The turn-based battles are viewed from an isometric perspective. During the battles, the heroes can execute physical attacks, defend, use items, or execute special martial arts or spells unique to each character.

175673.overview: Senryaku Shōgi is a digital conversion of the traditional Japanese board game Shogi for one or two players. It features two main game modes: a match play mode against another player or the computer at seven different skill levels, and a "conquest" mode where the player must defeat a series of increasingly-difficult computer opponents. There are a variety of options including starting layouts and turn time limits, and the ability to save up to four previous matches in full to review later.

175674.overview:
First Window is not a game per se, but an interactive multimedia which focuses on the twelve heroines from the main game and by being released prior to the actual game, provided introductory into what was to be expected from the game, at least graphics, voice-acting, and heroines-wise. Second Window disc was included as a bonus disc with retail release of the game. With First Window, the player can check video that shows the audition for all twelve heroines, and separate set of 12 short videos containing introductory speech from each of the selected voice-actresses for the roles. Additionally, player can check detailed info about the heroines with an interactive gallery that requires user interaction to play through to the end, otherwise remaining idle with the same background music.

This supplementary fandisk also comes with a 12-months calendar, similar in style to the one released with the original game. The calendar starts from April 1997 to March 1998, featuring one heroine per month. Featured heroines in order are Kaho Morii (April), Honoka Sawatari (May), Asuka Hoshino (June), Emiru Nagakura (July), Rurika Yamamoto (August), Wakana Ayasaki (September), Akira Endou (October), Chie Matsuoka (November), Yuu Nanase (December), Taeko Adachi (January), Miyuki Hosaka (February), and Manami Sugihara (March).

175675.overview: "Sento Monogatari" Sono I is a compilation of three multimedia fortunetelling titles: Heisei Kaiunreki (Heisei Good Luck Reading), Tarot Uranai (Tarot Fortunetelling), and Seimei Handan (Name Judgement). The included titles were previously available as individual releases for the 3DO, but this compilation is the first and only release for both the Saturn and PlayStation. Each of these releases also includes a newly-created bonus mode: the Saturn version includes Yume Uranai (Dream Fortunetelling), while the PlayStation version includes Sem Libra no Heya (Sem Libra's Room), a daily lucky item reading.

175676.overview:
Shichisei Toushin Guyferd: Crown Kaimetsu Sakusen is a first-person adventure game based on the 1996 tokusatsu TV show Seven-Star Fighting God Guyferd. The player controls Kōichi Hayami, a journalist who has been abducted by the Crown crime syndicate and turned into a cyborg warrior by their experiments. Hayami must team up with the Guyferd, Gō Kazama, to escape the underground facility and take down Crown.

The game primarily consists of exploring the maze-like facility in first person. Computer terminals and other objects can be investigated to acquire information and keys to unlock new areas, as well as chips to upgrade the player's combat abilities. Hayami will occasionally encounter enemies which are fought in a simple turn-based combat system; defeating enemies will unlock their cards for use in a separate two-player battle mode. There is also a gallery of production artwork from the TV show.

175677.overview: Shichuu Suimei Pitagraph is a multimedia fortune-telling game based on Chinese Four Pillars astrology, which uses the date and time of a person's birth to divine their future. One or more players enter their information and can see various predictions about their health, fortune, and love prospects. Some activities are only available for groups, such as interpersonal compatibility rankings based on questions asked of each participant.

175685.overview:
The year is 20XX, and the world has long been in a state of relative peace since the end of World War II. But with the sudden arrival of mysterious UFOs all over the world, that peace has been shattered. The invaders indiscriminately attack the armies of the world, forcing them to either submit or face destruction. A warship called the Ragoh, developed by the Japanese Navy during World War II using alien technology but never put into action before the war ended, is the world's only hope for salvation.

Shin Kaitei Gunkan: Koutetsu no Kodoku is a sci-fi turn-based war strategy game based on the 1995 anime OVA series known internationally as Super Atragon. It is a hex-based game in the style of Daisenryaku, including land, air, and sea units but with a focus on naval combat as the player's main unit is a Navy warship. The player commands the Ragoh and its supporting units, assisting international UN forces around the world against the Atlantean invaders. The game is divided into a linear series of missions, and before each mission the player gets advisement from their crew and can adjust their units' stats and loadouts.

175686.overview:
Shinseiki Evangelion: Eva to Yukai na Nakama-tachi is a mahjong game featuring characters from three animated series created by Gainax: Neon Genesis Evangelion, Nadia: The Secret of Blue Water, and Gunbuster. Gameplay is standard Japanese-style 2-player riichi mahjong. The story involves Shinji receiving a mysterious invitation to a mahjong tournament, with the promise of the winner being granted a wish.

There are 17 different characters to play as or against, and four different scenarios each following a different character: Shinji from Evangelion, Jean from Nadia, Noriko from Gunbuster, and an unlockable scenario with Misato from Evangelion. There is also a free mode where the player can select any of the available characters to play a regular mahjong game against.

175713.overview:
Shōgi Matsuri is a digital conversion of the traditional Japanese board game Shogi for one or two players, featuring the endorsement of the Japan Shogi Association (JSA), which has been the main organizing body for professional Shogi in Japan since 1924. In addition to standard play against another player or the computer at three skill levels, it includes a number of additional modes and options:

• A tutorial for beginners to learn the basic rules of Shogi
• Viewable recordings of over 1000 professional Shogi matches
• A "next move" quiz where the player must choose the next move in 20 different situations (from a total of over 250), with the computer ranking the player's performance at the end
• A tournament mode that simulates several prominent real-life Shogi tournaments
• A prize mode where the player must solve several Shogi problems; successfully completing all of them displays a certificate that could be sent to the JSA for a Shogi-related prize
• Komaochi Jōseki, or Piece Drop mode where the player can practice specific situations at a disadvantage against the computer
• Tsume Shogi (Shogi Puzzle) mode with 400 problems at multiple difficulty levels to solve, including famous historical problems
• Shogi Quiz where the player must answer 30 true-or-false questions about Shogi
• A database of information about professional Shogi players circa 1995

175717.overview:
You're a regular everyday employee at a regular unremarkable company, but you've got a secret: you love mahjong, and you're incredibly good at it! One day your boss asks you to join him and a few other managers that night for a friendly game of mahjong, and you spot an opportunity to boost your career. Upon seeing your skills, your boss sees in you an opportunity for the company as well: you're now tasked with helping to entertain clients, customers, and partners at mahjong parlors! But remember, entertaining business partners isn't just about winning; you'll need to know when to let them win, and how to do so without them realizing it.

Shusse Mahjong Daisettai is a 4-way mahjong game with a twist: the win conditions aren't always to simply win the match. Of course, sometimes you must dominate your opponents, but sometimes you must let them win the game in order to win their favor. The story mode follows the nameless employee as he attempts to progress his career through mahjong games with bosses and business partners. There is also a free game mode where the goal is simply to win.

175723.overview: Simulation Zoo is, as the name suggests, a business simulation game similar to the well-known Theme Park, in which the player operates and manages a zoo. The player is a new CEO brought in to turn around a failing zoo, maintaining and expanding facilities, balancing income and expenses, and acquiring new exhibits. The game is viewed from an isometric perspective and proceeds in real-time. There are eight different scenarios to choose from, each focusing on a different biome such as river valley, jungle, or desert.

175724.overview: In this strategy role-playing game, you and your mercenary group decide which of the six warring factions to support on your journey to unify the land. Battles take place on a traditional turn-based movement grid, transitioning to real-time skirmishes between armies or between individual commanders.

175725.overview:
Sotsugyou III: Wedding Bell is the third main entry in the Graduation series. The player takes the role of a high school teacher who must help a group of students with their studies by coordinating their schedules, to help them reach graduation. The twist in this entry is that the player character is married to one of their students — selected from the five girls at the start of the game — and has to keep this a secret until the end of the school year.

As in previous titles, the player must give assignments and advice to each of the students according to their strengths and weaknesses, in order to best help them raise their status to reach graduation. The player also takes their wife out on dates on the weekend, but must be careful not to run into the other students while they are out together so as not to arouse suspicion. Information on the other students' activities can be gathered to help the player know which locations will be safe for dates on any given weekend.

175726.overview:
Sound Novel Tkool 2 is a game creation toolkit that allows the user to create their own sound novel adventure games. It is part of ASCII's Tkool series of such software packages, and a follow-up to the prior Super Famicom edition. It allows the player to write the text of their story, choose background and character graphics, then add music, sound effects, and visual effects from a large variety of premade assets.

This updated edition contains a broader selection of assets for the player to use in their games, and now includes photograph and illustrated character sprite options in addition to the silhouettes of the previous release. There are also four sample games in different genres included. The later Sega Saturn version of the game contains additional assets, adds keyboard input support for text, and replaces one of the sample games with a new one.

175727.overview: The Star Bowling Vol. 2 directly expands on the first game's concept, providing five more real-life actresses to bowl with. As before, winning against each girl will unlock video clips of them, and there are multiple ball and lane types to choose from. New in this edition is a trial mode where the player must clear a sequence of pin setups with a limited number of balls, and the multiplayer mode now supports up to four players.

175728.overview: The Star Bowling is a 3D bowling game where the player competes against one of five real-life voice actresses. The main story mode has the player select a girl and play against them in multiple games; winning against each opponent will unlock video clips of that girl in a bonus gallery on the second disc. Various ball and lane variations are included, and there is also a two-player versus mode.

175729.overview:
Something strange has been happening in Kamiyōga recently. Young girls have been falling into inexplicable comas, one after another. Suchie-Pai, defender of justice, believes that someone or something sinister is causing all this, but needs help finding the true culprit and saving the people of Kamiyōga!

Doki Doki Nightmare ("The Throbbing Nightmare") is a Japanese-style adventure game with dating elements. The game is a spinoff of the popular Suchie-Pai strip-mahjong series. The player is given a week to travel around the city of Kamiyōga, interacting with its (primarily young and female) inhabitants to discover who has caused the strange curse on the city. The player can travel to a large number of locations throughout the city, and depending on what the player does and where, different story branches are unlocked.

In addition to the main game, the second disc features several minigames and a variety of bonus materials. After the game is cleared, it is also possible to ask other characters out on a date if their relationship has significantly progressed. Additionally, CG scenes and movies unlocked in the main game can also be reviewed here.

175730.overview:
Sugoventure revolves around the four main heroines from the Dragon Master Silk series, Aka, Ao, Ki and Ruli, with the addition of a fifth heroine-- a hapless ordinary high school girl, Mitsuki Shirafuji, who is summoned into their world and joins them on their adventure.

The gameplay revolves around a board game setting; in accordance with the number of heroines, up to 5 players can take part (the Saturn's 6 Player Adaptor peripheral is required for this). When each player is controlling their character, they have the option of selecting dialogue choices before their turn, to influence how the character may feel about them.

179156.overview: Shin Theme Park is an updated and localized remake of Theme Park specifically for the Japanese market. It plays much the same as the original game, but the visual style has been overhauled to be cuter, and there are numerous new attractions and events added specific to this version, including attractions representing specific countries.

180199.overview:
Dr. Wily is at it again! This time he's uncovered an ancient temple that houses a super computer he uses to recreate some of his old robots (from Mega Man 2 and Mega Man 3). Another added bonus of this computer is that it can affect anything electrical, which he of course uses to his advantage. Rockman's sister, Roll, is one of the first to get affected by it. Dr. Light manages to make Rockman and his friends (the robots from the first Mega Man) immune to the evil computer and they set off to stop Dr. Wily once again on the island where he's hiding.

The game plays out like an interactive anime TV mini-series where each disc in the game is an "episode" with opening and ending credits. The player basically follows the plot through numerous movie clips and every now and then is asked to make decisions, be it a reply to a character, the left or right path, or even some quick time events. Aside from this, the player is also thrown into battles at certain key points of the game, where the game switches to a static first-person view in which the player has to kill whatever enemy or boss has crossed Rockman's path.

In true Mega Man/Rockman fashion, Rockman absorbs the powers of any boss he defeats along the way, to be used against another boss later on in the game or any difficult enemies he encounters.

181563.overview:
Saturn CG Selection (サターンＣＧセレクション) is a digital museum of CG Videos and Images for the Sega Saturn, released exclusively in Japan. It is part of the Saturn Super series of Magazines, with the release being advertised alongside earlier volumes in the series in the "back issues" section of later volumes. Otherwise, it is seemingly a somewhat little known release, and as such is difficult to come by.

The disc contains the CG Intro videos for 8 different Saturn games and bonus CG image galleries for 7 of them. It was included as a bonus to a MOOK (Magazine and Book combo) of the same title, which is thought to contain CG images of the 8 featured games.

All CG videos on the disc are encoded using Cinepak. During the CG Gallery content on the disc, an audio track from the respective game will play in the background, usually from said games CG intro, although this is not always the case (During Panzer Dragoon's CG Image Gallery, the music from the first level plays instead).

Strangely, the audio files that play during the CG Image galleries are actually Cinepak files without a video track, which can sometimes mean that certain sound effects from CG Intro Videos are heard during the galleries (Such as the "shine" sound effect from Clockwork Knight: Pepperouchau no Daibouken Gekan).

181893.overview:
Sorvice is a roguelike action RPG with a card-collection element to combat and progression. The game is divided into two main parts, both accessible from the overworld map. In the quest mode, the player fights their way through a dungeon of 100 floors, similar to the Mystery Dungeon series, collecting cards, items, and money; the dungeon layout is randomly generated and is different on every attempt. In the duel mode, the player fights one-on-one against various opponents in an arena, with the story advancing as the player increases their ranking. Both modes let the player create a deck of cards which allow for using various attack and defense abilities and even to summon creatures to help fight; there are over 800 unique cards and items to find.

There are two playable characters to choose from: Rude is seeking revenge for the murder of his adoptive father, while Altina is searching for her missing brother. Each character has different abilities a unique story, and will find different cards in the dungeon. There is also a multiplayer mode which allows two players to fight a duel, as well as to trade cards.

181900.overview: This special edition of Shin Megami Tensei: Devil Summoner includes the game itself, an expanded manual with liner notes and extra information on each character, as well as two bonus CDs. The first one is the individually released Devil Summoner: Akuma Zensho, a companion disc for the game that includes new artwork and expanded information on all creatures and locations in the game, while the second is a mini-CD with arranged music tracks and commentary audio by the developers.

182528.overview:
Sega Screams Volume 1 is a demo disc for the Sega Saturn, released exclusively in North America with console bundles. Bizarrely Sega of America released this game twice - initially as Sega Saturn Bootleg II (as a "sequel" to Bootleg Sampler). The product in its Bootleg II form is far less common, though aside from a changed title screen (on some discs), the two discs are identical.

Unlike Bootleg Sampler, Sega Screams Volume 1 opts for the "standard" Saturn demo disc menus often seen in the European Sega Flash series.

Sega Screams Volume 1 was followed by Sega Screams Volume 2.

Playable demos:
• Three Dirty Dwarves (1996-09-20 demo)
• Bug Too! (1996 demo)
• Daytona USA: Champion Circuit Edition (1996-10-18 demo)
• Cyber Troopers Virtual-On (1996-10-04 demo)
• Baku Baku Animal (1996-04-15 demo)

Videos:
• Mr. Bones
• Fighting Vipers
• Virtua Cop 2
• Dark Savior
• Sega Worldwide Soccer 97

182529.overview:
Sega Saturn Choice Cuts is a demo disc for the Sega Saturn, released exclusively in North America. It was the first Saturn demo disc to hit American shores, and was bundled with all new consoles during 1995.

Most likely due to its early release, there aren't actually any playable demos in Sega Saturn Choice Cuts, just gameplay footage of upcoming or recently released titles, along with promotional material.

182913.overview: This special release of Puyo Puyo Sun is modified to exclusively support online multiplayer functionality via the Sega Saturn Modem and XBand service. Released at a lower price, most of the single-player content has been removed from this version, with only the single-player endless mode available for offline play.

182960.overview: Sega Saturn Internet Vol. 1 is internet software designed for the Sega Saturn Modem in Japan.

188375.overview:
Street Fighter Zero 2' or Street Fighter Zero 2 Dash is an updated version of Street Fighter Alpha 2. Originally released as part of Street Fighter Collection, the game was re-released separately in Japan under the Satakore label in 1998. In the West, this game is usually known as Street Fighter Alpha 2 Gold.

The game is a one-on-one fighting game and mostly identical to Street Fighter Zero 2. It includes a new secret character, Cammy (as she appeared in X-Men vs. Street Fighter), selectable only in the Versus and Training modes. In addition to the EX characters from the base game, EX versions of Ryu, Ken, Chun-Li, Sagat, and Vega are present (and all EX characters have been made easier to select). A Gouki Mode has been added where the player faces Shin Gouki without needing to unlock him. However, the Saturn-exclusive Illustrations feature has been removed. Some characters have new moves and Super Combos.
